description: Custom HTML elements that build interactive 3D scenes on the PlayCanvas Engine declaratively, with attribute-driven configuration and a small JavaScript API for engine access.
rules: Load the engine and the components through an import map with entries for 'playcanvas' and '@playcanvas/web-components'; the engine is a peer dependency and is never bundled.
Multi-value attributes are space-separated strings: position="0 1 -3", rotation="0 45 0", scale="2 2 2". Colors accept a CSS color name, a hex code, or 3 or 4 numbers in the range 0 to 1.
Component tags such as pc-camera, pc-light, pc-render and pc-rigid-body go directly inside a pc-entity, pc-model or pc-node, one of each kind per host.
Declare resources once as pc-asset, pc-material and pc-wasm children of pc-app, then reference them from the scene by id.
An absent attribute applies the engine default; an invalid value logs a console warning and applies the default. Remove an attribute to reset it rather than setting it to an empty string.
From JavaScript, await whenReady('pc-app') (or any selector or element) before reading .app, .entity or .component; those accessors are null until the element is ready.
For update loops or per-entity behavior, write a pc.Script and attach it with pc-script-instance instead of driving entities from page scripts.

The complete tag and attribute reference is indexed at https://developer.playcanvas.com/user-manual/web-components/llms.txt; consult it instead of inferring attribute names from examples. The JavaScript API, such as whenReady and the element classes, is indexed at https://api.playcanvas.com/web-components/llms.txt.
